description: Listen to YouTube together: create a room, share the code, and everyone hears the same queue in sync.
view.name: Room
config.displayName: Name shown to the other people in a room. If empty, SyncRoom asks the first time.
config.browserPath: Full path to a Chromium-based browser (Edge, Chrome, Brave, Chromium) used to play audio. Leave empty to find one automatically.
config.directConnections: Connect directly to the other people in the room (WebRTC). Faster, but they can see your IP address. Turn off to use relays only.
config.relays: Nostr relays used when a direct connection is not possible. Messages are encrypted with a key derived from the room code.
